parameters.name: ImageCategory
parameters.description:
The source of the image. Valid values:

*   Public: public images provided by Alibaba Cloud.
*   Custom: the custom image that you added.

parameters.name: ImageType
parameters.description:
The type of the images. Valid values:

*   VM: virtual machine image.
*   Container: the container image.

Default value: VM

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ehpcinstant get-image --image-category Custom --image-type VM --image-id m-2ze74g5mvy4pjg00000 --additional-region-ids example-string --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ehpcinstant GetImage --region cn-hangzhou --AdditionalRegionIds '["example-string"]' --ImageCategory Custom --ImageId 'm-2ze74g5mvy4pjg00000' --ImageType VM
